svg.title: With keep first, Remove Duplicates keeps the first Grace row, whose age is null. If it runs before Drop Nulls, Drop Nulls then deletes that row and no Grace is left. Dropping nulls first removes the bad copy and keeps Grace with age 85.
svg.text: drop nulls before you remove duplicates
the null-age copy wins the duplicate check, then gets dropped
only the age-85 copy reaches the duplicate check
